description: This JavaScript file provides API functions for fetching user analytics data, including tenant user summaries and active user trends, by making HTTP GET requests to specific endpoints and processing the responses.

methods.name: normalizeQuery(params = {})
methods.description: Helper function to sanitize and convert query parameters, including date conversions to ISO strings and handling of boolean or undefined values.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummary(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches tenant-wise user summaries with optional filters like date range, status, and activity inclusion. Handles API responses and errors gracefully, returning a standardized object.

methods.name: getActiveUsersTrend(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches time-based trend data of active users, optionally scoped by tenant, with response normalization and error handling.
